title: Artinian lifting gives a conormal retraction modulo the maximal ideal
statement:
Let $R,A$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure on $A$, let $\mathfrak q$ be a prime ideal of $A$, and put $S=A_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let $P$ be an extension of $R$-algebras, namely a commutative $R$-algebra $C$ with a surjective $R$-algebra map $C\to S$. Assume $C$ is a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Put $J=\ker(C\to S)$, $N=J/J^2$, $M=S\otimes_C\Omega_{C/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials, def-weil-module-base-change], and let $\delta:N\to M$ be the $S$-linear conormal map $[x]\mapsto 1\otimes\mathrm dx$. Write $\mathfrak n$ for the maximal ideal of $S$.

Assume that for every surjection $\varphi:B'\to B$ of Artinian local commutative rings with $\operatorname{length}_{B'}(\ker\varphi)=1$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length], and maps $\rho:R\to B'$, $a:A\to B$ such that $a\circ(R\to A)=\varphi\circ\rho$ and $a^{-1}(\mathfrak m_B)=\mathfrak q$, there is $a':A\to B'$ with $\varphi\circ a'=a$ and $a'\circ(R\to A)=\rho$. Then there is an $S$-linear map $v:M/\mathfrak nM\to N/\mathfrak nN$ such that $v\circ\operatorname{quot}_M\circ\delta=\operatorname{quot}_N$. Here $R,A,C$ lie in $\mathrm{Type}\ u$ and the test rings may lie in $\mathrm{Type}\,(\max(u,v))$ for any universe $v$.

proof.text: Write S=A_q, C=P.Ring, J=ker(C -> S), m=maximalIdeal C, and n=maximalIdeal S. A surjection of local rings pulls n back to m, so J is contained in m. For each N>=1 form E_N=C/(J^2+m^N) and F_N=C/(J+m^N). These are nonzero Artinian local rings by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-quotient-artinian-local]; their quotient map has square-zero kernel. The natural map A -> S -> F_N pulls the maximal ideal back to q. The R-algebra structures give the required commuting square.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-artinian-ideal-length-one-filtration] to the kernel of E_N -> F_N. Quotient E_N by the filtration ideals, obtaining a finite chain of surjections with kernel of length one over the source ring. Every quotient stays Artinian local because its preimage ideal in C contains m^N and lies in m. Starting with A -> F_N, apply the hypothesis by descending induction. For each step the maximal ideal pulls back to the source maximal ideal, so the preimage in A stays q. The result is a lift s_N:A -> E_N over R.

An element of A outside q has image outside the maximal ideal of E_N, hence a unit by [lem-weil-pbc-local-ring-unit-criterion]. Localization gives an R-algebra map S -> E_N. It takes n into the maximal ideal, whose N-th power is zero, so quotient universality gives F_N=S/n^N -> E_N. Its composite with E_N -> F_N is the identity: the composite agrees with the identity on A, and maps out of this localization followed by a quotient are determined by A. Thus E_N -> F_N has an R-algebra section.
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-square-zero-section-conormal-retraction] to the section. It gives an F_N-linear left inverse to ker(E_N -> F_N) -> F_N tensor_(E_N) Omega(E_N/R).

By [lem-weil-pbc-artin-rees], choose c>=1 with m^N intersect J contained in m^(N-c) J for N>=c, and set N=c+1. Tensor the preceding left inverse with S/n. The modular law identifies the source as J/(J^2+(m^N intersect J)+mJ)=J/(J^2+mJ)=(J/J^2)/n(J/J^2). Apply [lem-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials-mod-power-ideal] to C,J with exponent 1 and to C/J^2, its maximal ideal with exponent N-1. Since N>=2, both applications are valid, and after tensoring with S/n the target is (S tensor_C Omega(C/R))/n(S tensor_C Omega(C/R)). The maps on classes of x in J both send x to dx, hence equal the reduction of P.cotangentComplex. The transported left inverse gives vk and the equation in the statement.

Test rings originally lie in Type u. Transport them and their maps to Type (max u v) with ULift ring equivalences. Surjectivity, module length one, local and Artinian instances, and both composite equations are invariant under these equivalences. Descend the resulting lifts. If J=0, the conormal module is zero and the conclusion is automatic; zero-variable presentations and arbitrary residue characteristic require no further assumptions.

theorem artinian_lifting_conormal_split_mod_maximal
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime]
    (P : Extension.{u} R (Localization.AtPrime q))
    [IsLocalRing P.Ring] [IsNoetherianRing P.Ring]
    (hlift : ∀ (B' B : Type (max u v)) [CommRing B'] [CommRing B]
      [IsArtinianRing B'] [IsArtinianRing B] [IsLocalRing B'] [IsLocalRing B]
      (φ : B' →+* B), Function.Surjective φ → Module.length B' (RingHom.ker φ) = 1 →
      ∀ (ρ : R →+* B') (a : A →+* B),
        a.comp (algebraMap R A) = φ.comp ρ →
          Ideal.comap a (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) = q →
        ∃ a' : A →+* B', φ.comp a' = a ∧ a'.comp (algebraMap R A) = ρ) :
    ∃ vk : (P.CotangentSpace ⧸
          ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)) •
            (⊤ : Submodule (Localization.AtPrime q) P.CotangentSpace))) →ₗ[Localization.AtPrime q]
        (P.Cotangent ⧸
          ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)) •
            (⊤ : Submodule (Localization.AtPrime q) P.Cotangent))),
        vk.comp ((((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)) •
            (⊤ : Submodule (Localization.AtPrime q) P.CotangentSpace)).mkQ).comp
              P.cotangentComplex) =
          ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)) •
            (⊤ : Submodule (Localization.AtPrime q) P.Cotangent)).mkQ
